sections.title: Room for *every event*

image.alt: The sand arena at Highfields, with barns beyond

body: Highfields Event Center is a 74-acre event facility and RV park just eight blocks from historic downtown Aiken. It has hosted horse shows of every discipline, and has plenty of room for non-equestrian events too.
Centrally located between Florida and the Northeast, we offer dry stall rentals for short or seasonal layovers for the traveling equestrian, and an RV park with room for your rig.
list: The Mary Ann Parmelee Pavilion: 48 × 100 feet, opened in 2016, with power and water
Barns, stabling tents, a polo and derby field and paddocks
Day ship-in parking and vendor space

columns.title: Northwest gate
items: Polo and derby field, paddocks, ship-in parking and vendors

columns.title: From I-20
items: Take exit 22 onto US 1 toward Aiken

items.q: How do I enter a show?
items.a: Online through Ring Radar, from each show’s page. Prize lists and schedules are posted for every show.

items.q: Can I reserve stalls or a camper spot?
items.a: Yes. Use the stall and bedding or camper reservation forms, or call (803) 649-3505.

items.q: Can I lay over with my horses between Florida and the Northeast?
items.a: Yes. Dry stalls are available for short-term and seasonal layovers; call for availability and rates.

items.q: Who do I ask about points, membership or sponsorship?
items.a: Call (803) 649-3505 or email psjshows87@gmail.com, and we’ll point you to the right person.
Yes. The grounds have room for non-equestrian events as well as horse shows.
